title: German Chicken Skewers with Toasted Brazilian Peanuts
description: A flavorful and healthy German-inspired dish featuring chicken skewers, toasted Brazilian peanuts, and a hint of spice.

ingredients.name: red bell pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces
German seasoning (such as paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder)

instructions: Thread chicken, onion, bell pepper, and zucchini onto skewers.
Brush skewers with olive oil and season with salt, black pepper, and German seasoning.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast peanuts in a dry skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently, until fragrant and lightly browned.
Serve skewers hot with toasted peanuts on top.
Garnish with fresh parsley, if desired.
